issue: Unused/Dead Component & Invalid Reference: PROJECT_NUMBER is hidden and never used in the active page flow. Additionally, it calls non-existent component PROJECT_LOV.reset() and TASK_LOV.reset().
fix: Remove this unused component (and its child TASK_NUMBER) entirely from the screen definition to clean up dead code and avoid referencing non-existent objects.

issue: Unused/Dead Component & Invalid Reference: PROJECT_NUMBER is hidden and never used in the active page flow. Additionally, it calls non-existent component PROJECT_LOV.reset() and TASK_LOV.reset().
fix: Remove this unused component (and its child TASK_NUMBER) entirely from the screen definition to clean up dead code and avoid referencing non-existent objects.

issue: Unused/Dead Component & Invalid Reference: TASK_NUMBER is hidden and never used in the active page flow. Additionally, it calls non-existent component TASK_LOV.reset().
fix: Remove this unused component from the screen definition entirely.

issue: Unsafe chained call: REM_SR_QTY.getValue().replace(".0", ""). If REM_SR_QTY.getValue() returns null, throws NullPointerException.
fix: Add null check: String remQty = REM_SR_QTY.getValue(); flexi.putObject("QTY_SR", remQty != null ? remQty.replace(".0", "") : "0");

issue: Direct result.getString("...") calls without verifying result.has("...") (e.g. ReturnStatus, LotNumber, StartSerialNumber, EndSerialNumber, ReturnMessageText).
fix: Guard with result.has("key") before reading, or use result.optString("key", "").

issue: Malformed check: if(SERIAL_TYPE.getValue().length () > 0 && SERIAL_TYPE.getValue().length () != null). Primitive int cannot be compared to null, and .length() throws NPE if getValue() is null.
fix: Replace with if (SERIAL_TYPE.getValue() != null && !SERIAL_TYPE.getValue().trim().isEmpty()).

issue: Unsafe method call on object: flexi.getObject("SERIAL_CONTROL_CODE").equals("5"). Throws NPE if SERIAL_CONTROL_CODE is null.
fix: Invert comparison: "5".equals(flexi.getObject("SERIAL_CONTROL_CODE")).

issue: Unsafe chained call: flexi.getObject("REVISION_CONTROL_FLAG").toString(). Throws NPE if object is null.
fix: Check for null: Object revFlag = flexi.getObject("REVISION_CONTROL_FLAG"); if ("true".equals(revFlag != null ? revFlag.toString() : "")).

issue: Unsafe array item retrieval: orgArray.get(0).get("ManagementBusinessUnitId") without checking orgArray.length() > 0 or validating index 0.
fix: Check if (orgArray != null && orgArray.length() > 0) before indexing.

issue: Unsafe .toString() on JSON element: serialArray.get(i).get("FromSerialNumber").toString();. Throws NPE if value is null.
fix: Use optString("FromSerialNumber") or verify nullness before calling .toString().

issue: Unsafe Double.parseDouble(REM_LOT_QTY.getValue()) and Double.parseDouble(REM_SR_QTY.getValue()) without null or empty validation.
fix: Validate getValue() != null && !getValue().trim().isEmpty() before parsing.

issue: API call GENERATE_LOT_WS.callWebService(null); and JSON parsing new org.json.JSONObject(...) are not enclosed in a try-catch block.
fix: Wrap in try-catch; on failure, alert user with flexi.setStatusMessage(...).

issue: Swallowed exceptions: catch (Exception e) { logger.trace("Exception while generating Serial: "+ e); }. Only traces error and silently continues, leaving user in an unhandled state.
fix: Log logger.error("Serial generation error", e); and display flexi.setStatusMessage("Serial generation failed: " + e.getMessage());.

issue: API call ORG_BU_WEBSERVICE.callWebService(null); and new JSONObject(...) lack try-catch block.
fix: Wrap in try-catch block with error logging and status message.

issue: PO_TOLERANCE_WS.callWebService(null); and JSON parsing executed without try-catch.
fix: Wrap in try-catch block.

issue: ITEMS_V2.callWebService(null); and JSON parsing executed without try-catch.
fix: Wrap in try-catch block.

issue: ITEM_REVISION_WS.callWebService(null); and JSON parsing executed without try-catch.
fix: Wrap in try-catch block.

issue: ITEM_TRANSACTION_DEAFAULT_WS.callWebService(null); and JSON parsing executed without try-catch.
fix: Wrap in try-catch block.

issue: ORG_PARAM_WEBSERVICE.callWebService(null); and JSON parsing executed without try-catch.
fix: Wrap in try-catch block.

issue: PO_LINE_DTLS_WS, PO_LINE_CHILD_SCH_WS, and PO_LINE_PRJ_DFF_WS calls lack try-catch handling.
fix: Wrap all REST execution blocks and JSON response parsing in comprehensive try-catch blocks.

issue: LPN_INV_WS.callWebService(); and new org.json.JSONObject(...) executed without try-catch.
fix: Enclose in try-catch block with UI error reporting.

issue: Numeric parsing Double.parseDouble(...) executed without try-catch for REM_LOT_QTY and REM_SR_QTY.
fix: Enclose parsing inside a try-catch for NumberFormatException.

issue: Unused/Dead Field Dependency: PROJECT_NUMBER is hidden and never used on the page. Its focus script attempts to reset non-existent TASK_LOV.
fix: Remove PROJECT_NUMBER and TASK_NUMBER from the screen definition entirely, or if needed in future, ensure proper component IDs are referenced.

issue: Changing PO_NUM does not fully reset child line/item fields (ITEM_NUMBER, ITEM_DESC, QTY, LOT_NUMBER, SERIAL_NUMBER) if the user navigates back and selects another PO.
fix: Implement complete child field reset in PO_NUM _onExit before populating new PO header data.

issue: Changing SUBINVENTORY does not reset or re-validate LOCATOR value if modified directly. Stale locator from previous subinventory may persist.
fix: Add LOCATOR.reset(); and flexi.removeObject("LOCATOR_ID"); in SUBINVENTORY _onExit.

issue: Switching between "Individual" and "Range" leaves stale serial arrays and ranges in session objects (SERIAL_ARRAY, TEMP_HASH, RANGE_SERIAL_PARAM).
fix: Clear all serial session objects and reset opposite serial input fields on serial type change.

issue: flexi.closeApplication(true); terminates the screen without cleaning up over 60 stored session/flexi objects (e.g., PAYLOAD, PRINT_PAYLOAD, FILES_ARR_LIST, SERIAL_ARRAY, LOT_SERIAL_ARRAY, TEMP_FILE_AL). Stale objects remain in memory context.
fix: Call a cleanup method that executes flexi.removeObject(...) on all screen keys before closing.

issue: Only INPUT_LABEL_REQUESTS is removed on page entry. Leftover data from prior cancelled or completed transactions persists across invocations.
fix: Explicitly flush all transaction objects, arrays, and payload caches on page entry.

issue: Large constructed JSON payloads (PAYLOAD, PRINT_PAYLOAD) and file attachments (FILES_ARR_LIST, TEMP_FILE_HASH) are retained in session after transaction completion.
fix: Explicitly call flexi.removeObject("PAYLOAD");, flexi.removeObject("PRINT_PAYLOAD");, and clear attachment lists upon submission.
